entities.name: CLI
entities.description: Contains the identification of the calling line for the mobile terminating call in the CS domain, which triggered the paging via SGs.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that sends the CLI IE when it was received via SGs.

entities.name: CS Domain Mobile Terminating Call
entities.description: A mobile terminating call in the CS domain that triggers paging via SGs.

entities.name: SGs Interface
entities.description: Interface used for communication between MSC and MME for CS fallback and SMS.
